preconditions.description: Input integers a, b, m satisfy 1 ≤ a, b ≤ 1000 and 0 ≤ m ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= int(a) and 1 <= int(y) <= int(b) for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (x, y) has 1 ≤ x ≤ a and 1 ≤ y ≤ b.
No multiple edges exist in the input.

postconditions.expression: int(c) == min_colors and all(1 <= int(color) <= int(c) for color in colors)
postconditions.description: The first line of output is the minimal number of colors c, and the second line contains m colors (1 ≤ color ≤ c) for each edge in input order.

postconditions.expression: all(colors[i] != colors[j] for i in range(int(m)) for j in range(int(m)) if edges[i] != edges[j] and share_vertex(edges[i], edges[j]))
postconditions.description: No two adjacent edges (sharing a common vertex) have the same color.
